reviewNote: Drafted by Claude from the chart for faculty review. Not validated teaching content.
summary: 7 y with level 3 autism for dental rehab with nasal intubation; IM ketamine premed worked beautifully in 2024 after a traumatic mask induction in 2022; apple juice 90 min before; asthma not examined.

decision.rationale: Clear liquids at 0830 meet a 1 h pediatric clear fluid policy (if your institution uses 2 h, start at 1030). Repeat the proven IM ketamine plan with mother present.

redFlags.finding: Uncooperative child with a proven premedication plan
redFlags.evidence: 2022 sevo mask induction needed 3 staff and desaturated; 2024 IM ketamine 4 mg/kg in mother's lap was smooth; vitals refused today.
redFlags.implication: Forced mask induction is traumatic and risky.
redFlags.action: IM ketamine (about 4 mg/kg) with mother present, then IV and standard monitors once sedated.

redFlags.evidence: Apple juice 4 oz at 0830; case 1000; milk and crackers 0145.
redFlags.implication: Meets a 1 h pediatric clear policy, not a 2 h policy.

redFlags.finding: Asthma not assessed and premed albuterol refused
redFlags.evidence: Albuterol 10/14 for cough; refused spacer today; lungs not auscultated.
redFlags.implication: Bronchospasm with nasal and oral instrumentation.
redFlags.action: Auscultate after sedation; albuterol through the circuit after induction.

redFlags.implication: Epistaxis and a retained throat pack.
redFlags.action: Vasoconstrictor to the nares, lubricated warmed tube, document and count the throat pack removal.

redFlags.evidence: 2022 ABR; 2024 calm emergence in a dim room with mother.
redFlags.action: Calm environment, mother at bedside, consider dexmedetomidine or propofol at end.

planItems.item: IM ketamine premedication, then IV induction
Acetaminophen, local by dentist, minimal opioid

boothComplications.why: Blood and secretions in the airway at emergence
